Subject: Monthly forecast cleanroom: stage reconciliations & leadership packet assembly

Team —

It's that time for the monthly cleanroom ahead of the QBRs. Key asks for this thread:

1) By EOD Wed (6/30) please update SFDC stage tags and the commit column for any deals you own or shadow. We need parity between the rep view and the forecast view.
2) Add a one-line reason for any stage movement in the "stage_change_log_06-29.csv" (attached) — e.g., "Net new scope; delivery date pushed" or "Legal reviewing contract, awaiting signature".
3) Aditya: please prepare the consolidated commit spreadsheet (include probability, expected close date, and last contact).
4) Grace & Tessa: I'll need short bullets for the leadership packet per major deal (max 2 lines each) — highlight 1 risk and 1 mitigation.

I'm attaching a blank stage log and a template for the exec pack. We'll compile a single pack for leaders by Thursday AM and circulate for review. If any deal requires an SLA or credit exception note the reason in your line.

Thanks — short, specific updates only.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: commit_spreadsheet_06-28.xlsx (spreadsheet), stage_change_log_06-29.csv (csv), exec_pack_template_v2.pptx (pptx)

Lauren —

Thanks for the heads-up. I'm attaching my working sheet: I've reconciled reps' commits against opportunities flagged as "commit" in SFDC, and removed duplicates where two owners were listed. High-level notes:

- RNW-2027-1423 (Acme Corp): Moved from Negotiation -> Commit. Legal asked for small indemnity rewrite; vendor counsel expects sign by 7/8. Probability moved to 85%.
- RNW-2027-1369 (Maple Analytics): Moved from Commit -> Commit (unchanged) — still on track, engineering POC scheduled next week.
- RNW-2027-1402 (Orchid Health): Dropped to Commit-Pending (prob 50%) — procurement requested SOC2 artifact and time to review.

I've uploaded "commit_spreadsheet_06-28.xlsx" to the Drive link. I'll finalize coverage by EOD Wed and mark rows that require leadership callouts.

Attaching: commit_spreadsheet_06-28.xlsx (current working copy)

— Aditya

Please review the highlighted deals (Acme, Orchid, Nova) and provide any corrections by 9:00 AM PT tomorrow.

External stakeholders: Lisa / Contracts — we're sharing the current status so you know the timing. No action required unless you see an issue.

I'll assemble the final deck Thursday AM and loop in leadership for a 10-minute sign-off.

Thanks — Lauren
